content.text:

At this point, it seems you've found the "evidence" you needed to justify the path you actually want to take. 

Whether you are joking or using these fictional sources to signal that you've decided to prioritize experience over your previous values, the result is the same: **You've reached a conclusion.**

Just remember: the most "legit" council in the world is your own conscience. As long as you are making a choice that makes you happy and you are practicing safety and consent, that is what matters. Enjoy your exploration!
